annotations.title: Validate a Google Merchant Center feed

description: Validate a product feed against the Google Merchant Center product specification. Takes the feed URL (XML or JSON) and returns a 0-100 score with findings on required attributes, price formatting, availability values and GTIN checksums. Use this when asked to check, debug or validate a Google Merchant / Google Shopping feed, or to explain why products might be disapproved.

url.description: Public URL of the product feed (XML or JSON).
